title: repeat_nested_forced_json
description: Issue #35 (universal): a multi-segment (dotted) repeat seed (e.g. `answer.item`, the canonical QuestionnaireResponse recursion) forces a field to raw JSON[] at a DEEPER navigation level than the scope element. A typed column navigating that field (`answer.item.linkId...`) must be re-typed at the divergence point, not only at the first segment off the element. The pre-#35-universal builder re-typed only single-segment seeds, so these silently leaked quote-wrapped JSON into typed columns (or threw on UNION ALL reconciliation). Distinct values throughout so the order-independent Set comparison cannot mask a duplicate.

tests.title: typed column navigates a dotted repeat-forced field (chain)
tests.description: repeat:["item","answer.item"] under a forEach:item forces both `item` and `answer.item` to JSON[] relative to the item element. The sibling typed column `answer.item.linkId.first()` navigates the dotted forced field — divergence is at the SECOND nav segment. Expected: the declared `string` value 'NESTED', not the quote-wrapped JSON '"NESTED"'.

tests.title: unionAll bridges a dotted repeat-forced field across a columns-only and a repeat branch
tests.description: A unionAll over the item element mixes a columns-only branch navigating the dotted forced field `answer.item.linkId` (aggregated with join() to a value distinct from every per-node value) with a repeat branch whose seed `answer.item` forces it. The columns-only branch must be bridged to the same typed structure so UNION ALL reconciles and emits typed values.
